mandatory_stp.event_first_byte_is_example: mandatory parser accepts bit7 set and ignores low sequence bits; do not constrain response to the example sequence without independent proof
mandatory_stp.padding: no SDIO alignment padding in BTIF mandatory branch

btif.selected_tx_handling: NEW_TX_HANDLING_SUPPORT is locally 1; normal send enqueues then enables TX interrupts. Inactive direct-write branch is not a proven live polling path.
btif.selected_rx_handling: receive helper delegates to interrupt-status-based byte drain; RX PIO setup enables interrupt. Fully IRQ-masked receive remains unverified.
btif.aliased_control: Vendor bit-set/clear macros read-modify-write offset 0x08, whose read identity is IIR and write identity FIFOCTRL. Do not copy this as a control-value readback.
btif.dma_enable_read_effect: Header says reading offset 0x4c resets timeout interrupt when automatic reset disabled; not an unconditionally passive observation.
btif.dma_engine_enable_offsets: TX and RX AP-DMA channel EN offsets are +0x08; separate from BTIF local DMA request bits. Clearing local request bits does not prove engine quiescence.
